messages.content: What did Arjuna do at Draupadi's swayamvara?
Dressed as a Brahmana, he strung the very stiff bow that the kings had failed to bend and shot down the mark set up above a machine in the sky. That won him Draupadi.
Which notes are missing in Raga Bhoopali?
Bhoopali has no Ma and no Ni, so it uses only five notes. It is a peaceful evening raga from the Kalyan family.
Why will the Longbourn estate go to Mr. Collins?
The estate is entailed on the male line, and Mr. Bennet has no son. So it will pass to his cousin, Mr. Collins.
In the Panchatantra, how does the Brahman's daydream about his jar of barley-meal end?
He imagines selling the meal, buying goats, cows and horses, and starting a family. Lost in his dream, he kicks out, smashes the jar, and is covered in white meal.
What does the Caterpillar ask Alice when they meet?
He asks, "Who are you?" She finds it hard to answer because she has changed size so many times that day.
In The Mice That Ate Iron, how does Naduk get his balance-beam back?
He hides the cheating merchant's son and claims a hawk carried the boy off. When the merchant says that is impossible, Naduk answers that so is mice eating iron.
How did Sugriva become king of the Vanars?
Rama killed Bali, Sugriva's brother, with an arrow during their fight. Sugriva then became king and sent his Vanars to search for Sita.
How could Sanjaya describe the war to the blind king Dhritarashtra?
The sage Vyasa gave Sanjaya divine sight. He could see everything happening on the battlefield and report it to the king.
How was Drona made to give up fighting?
Bhima killed an elephant named Aswatthaman and shouted that Aswatthaman was dead. Drona believed his son had died, especially when Yudhishthira confirmed it, and lost the will to fight.
The Duchess's baby changes after Alice carries it outside. Into what?
It turns into a pig. Alice sets it down, and it trots quietly away into the wood.
How is Count Dracula finally destroyed?
Jonathan cuts his throat with his great Kukri knife, and Quincey Morris plunges a bowie knife into his heart. The Count crumbles into dust.
When does Catherine Earnshaw die?
She dies two hours after giving birth to her daughter, Cathy, on the night of her last stormy meeting with Heathcliff.
How does the jackal Curd-Face find out that a lion is hiding in his cave?
He calls out to the cave as if it always answers him. The lion, fooled, roars a greeting back, and the jackal runs off, since a cave that talks must hide an enemy.
How does Alice's adventure in Wonderland end?
The whole pack of cards flies at her, and she wakes up on the bank with her head in her sister's lap. Her sister is brushing away leaves that have fluttered onto her face.
How did Dhritarashtra, Gandhari and Kunti die?
They had gone to live in the forest as ascetics. A forest fire broke out, and they died in it.
How does the rabbit Victory keep the elephants away from the Lake of the Moon?

He pretends to be a messenger of the Moon and says the Moon is angry with the elephants. When the elephant-king touches the water, Victory says he has angered the Moon even more, so the frightened king begs forgiveness and stays away.
Where do Holmes and Watson live together?
They share rooms at 221B Baker Street in London. After Watson marries, he moves out but still visits Holmes there.
Who fought Arjuna when he followed the sacrificial horse to Manipura?
His own son, Vabhruvahana. Arjuna fell in the fight, and Ulupi restored him to life with a special gem.
What happens when Rama tries the great bow at King Janak's court?
Rama lifts the huge bow that no one else could handle and draws the string so hard that it breaks in two. Janak is amazed and gives his daughter Sita to Rama in marriage.
What is the name of Captain Ahab's ship in Moby-Dick?
The ship is called the Pequod. Ahab sails it on his hunt for the White Whale, Moby Dick.
